title: Chapter 1421 - 5: Lin Yuan Going All Out
content:
Chapter 1421 - 5: Lin Yuan Going All Out

Chapter 1421: Chapter 5: Lin Yuan Going All Out

"Tai Chu is only the first of the ’Innate Five Great’."

"After it, there are four more, and each one represents a different stage of the path I walk."

Lin Yuan was in high spirits.

Through the ’Innate Five Great’, he had found the path he needed to follow in the future.

The Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao is the Dao he has comprehended for himself.

And the ’Innate Five Great’ is the extended path based on this Dao.

The former is the foundation, the latter is the direction, both equally important.

"Hmm?"

Just as Lin Yuan was planning to further comprehend the evolution of the Dao Origin of the fourth source world.

A sudden change in expression.

"Is the Wanwei Space-Time about to open?"

Lin Yuan gazed into the distance in a certain direction.

The Wanwei Space-Time is a special world created by the Lord Wanwei with everything he possessed.

When Lin Yuan learned of the existence of the Wanwei Space-Time, he established a causal connection with it, allowing him to smoothly sense the coordinates of the Wanwei Space-Time and thus approach it.

Of course, to truly enter the Wanwei Space-Time, one needs at least lord-level means.

Time beings of the First Realm or Second Realm, even if aware of the Wanwei Space-Time coordinates, cannot truly approach.

Time beings below the lord level can only enter the Wanwei Space-Time if led by a lord.

"The Taiji Primordial Spirit is about to arrive as well."

Lin Yuan thought to himself, recalling that, more than a hundred years ago, upon first learning of the Wanwei Space-Time, he sent the Taiji Primordial Spirit there.

Within the Wanwei Space-Time, lies the lifelong accumulated treasures of the legendary Lord Wanwei, though over countless ages, most of the treasures have been taken by various time beings.

Yet, even a slight gain could yield Lin Yuan a great profit.

"This time, the main objective for entering the Wanwei Space-Time is exploration; avoid unnecessary conflict without assurance."

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

According to the information provided by the Time-Space Shop owner, a normal lord entering the Wanwei Space-Time would encounter little danger as long as they’re not rash.

Moreover, they would invariably obtain treasures worth thousands of catties of time sand.

Though it can’t compare with the reward of ten thousand catties of time sand offered by the Lord of Ye Wu, at least Lin Yuan has room to make choices.

...

Outside the Wanwei Space-Time.

Lin Yuan’s Taiji Primordial Spirit observed the vast space in the distance.

The scale of the Wanwei Space-Time far exceeds that of top-tier dimensional spaces like the Chaos Void; it is vast and boundless, making it hard to shake even for Time Lords.

Swish, swish, swish.

With the opening of the Wanwei Space-Time, streams of consciousness quickly surged in.

The Wanwei Space-Time had been opened many times before, no need to be overly cautious.

After waiting a short while, Lin Yuan also entered the Wanwei Space-Time.

"Is this inside the Wanwei Space-Time?"

Following the surging currents of time-space, Lin Yuan finally landed on a piece of land, carefully surveying his surroundings.

"The suppression of the Dao is severe; it’s nearly impossible to perceive the timeline."

Lin Yuan wasn’t surprised, as he had already learned this information through intelligence reports.

In the Wanwei Space-Time, large-scale movement is difficult, and perception is heavily suppressed; moreover, Time Lords can hardly observe their own or others’ timelines here.

This rule—a law of iron—was set by the Lord Wanwei when the space-time was established, and even Time Lords must obey.

"Lord of Heaven Light attempted to become a Fourth Rank Perfect Time Being but ultimately failed, unable to do anything before perishing, yet Lord Wanwei had the ability to develop such a vast space-time..."

Lin Yuan’s thoughts churned.

This demonstrates that Lord Wanwei’s power likely surpasses that of the Lord of Heaven Light significantly.

"That’s the depths of the Wanwei Space-Time where Time Lords of the Second and Third Tiers head immediately upon entry."

Lin Yuan looked towards a certain direction, pondering.

"I won’t join in the commotion."

Lin Yuan shook his head.

Time Lords of the Second and Third Tiers do not enter the Wanwei Space-Time for treasure alone.

They are after the insights and comprehension related to Lord Wanwei’s paths to transcendence.

These insights are typically located deep within the Wanwei Space-Time.

Of course, there have been instances when treasures have appeared outside the depths during past openings of the Wanwei Space-Time, but such occurrences are extremely rare.

...

After briefly surveying his surroundings, Lin Yuan began his exploration in earnest.

The opening span of the Wanwei Space-Time is not lengthy—shortest a million years, longest ten million years.

For Time Lords, a million or ten million years? It’s but a fleeting moment.

Whoosh—Lin Yuan immediately chose a direction to explore, being able to rely only on flight to slowly search for treasures and opportunities in the Wanwei Space-Time due to perceptual suppression.

Boom!

Lin Yuan raised his hand, smashing the vast mountain range before him, yet found no valuable treasures.

"The Wanwei Space-Time has been opened many times, explored countless times." Lin Yuan shook his head slightly, understanding why the Second Tier peaks and Third Tier Time Lords head directly into the depths upon entry.

Perhaps the outer regions still hold treasures, but the search is challenging, suitable only for weaker lords to investigate.

"Hmm?"

Lin Yuan suddenly stopped, looking at a nearby hill and sensing a special energy, he immediately extended his hand.

The hill split open, revealing an octagonal crystal in Lin Yuan’s palm.

"Lord-level material?"

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face, recognizing the octagonal crystal as an excellent lord-level raw material, worth two thousand catties of time sand.

"My luck is quite good."

Lin Yuan felt a surge of satisfaction; he hadn’t been in here long and already made a discovery, whereas many time lords spend tens of thousands of years without finding any significant treasures.
